source.name: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D source-authored bone material domains
source.notes: These indices preserve exact author material selections on the actual reference bone geometry. Source material names identify cartilage/articular or suture/joint surface domains, not a complete anatomical region atlas. Named feature association is separate and recorded explicitly. Condyle, mandibular-head and stapes-footplate mappings cover their articular source patches only. Numeric sculpt face sets have no anatomical names and are metadata only. No reference domains are transferred to the CT specimen.

fingerprint_format: positions_sha256 hashes canonical C-order float32 little-endian XYZ vertices; indices_sha256 hashes C-order uint32 little-endian local triangle vertex indices; geometry_sha256 hashes their concatenation. Region byte offsets address uint32 local triangle IDs in this exact GLB face order.
